sections.h2: Lynnhaven Shores Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 112 residential sales closed in Lynnhaven Shores (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $419,000, close to the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 19 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Lynnhaven Shores sales closed between $325,000 and $560,250, or about $293 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($403,500, 56 sales) was about 9% lower than in the earlier 12 months ($443,450, 56 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Lynnhaven Shores sales were in ZIP code 23451.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Lynnhaven Shores
sections.html:
All of the sales were attached homes such as townhomes or condos. The median home was about 1,490 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,123 to 1,858 square feet. 57% of the homes that sold had 2 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1982 and 2005, with a median year built of 1990, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.
